extensions.claim_text: Lordstown has received pre-orders primarily from fleet operators to purchase over 44,000 Endurance vehicles; the pre-orders are non-binding and required no deposit.
extensions.endpoint_or_method: edgar_fts.query_fulltext with search_term='Endurance' or 'Lordstown' across major US fleet/leasing operators (Holman, ARI, Wheels, Element Fleet, Penske, FedEx, UPS) — if 44,000 trucks reflects real fleet-side intent, at least the largest LOI-signers should mention Endurance or Lordstown somewhere in their post-2020 filings
extensions.rationale: 44,000 trucks at $52,500 = ~$2.3B implied gross. Even split across 10-20 fleet counterparties this is a board-level capex commitment that would normally surface in a counterparty risk-factor or capex commentary. Total silence across all major US commercial-fleet operators in their own filings is a strong inflation signal.
extensions.expected_observable: count of fleet/leasing 10-K filings mentioning Endurance or Lordstown
extensions.signal_direction: 0-2 mentions across all major US fleet operators contradicts 44,000-unit fleet pre-order book
